diagrams.title: Cable protection — what senses what
diagrams.cap: Most cable faults are earth faults (insulation breakdown core → sheath), so a sensitive earth-fault relay is the key protection. Murray / Varley loop tests locate the fault after it is isolated.

diagrams.title: Three-core cable capacitance and distributor voltage drop
diagrams.cap: A three-core cable has core-to-sheath capacitances C<sub>s</sub> and core-to-core capacitances C<sub>c</sub>; turning the delta of C<sub>c</sub> into a star gives C<sub>N</sub> = C<sub>s</sub> + 3C<sub>c</sub> per phase. A distributor's drop is the sum of each section current times its resistance; a uniform load gives half the drop of the same total load at the far end.
diagrams.qq: Cs = 0.2 µF, Cc = 0.1 µF. Capacitance per phase?

diagrams.title: Dielectric stress in a single-core cable
diagrams.cap: Stress is highest at the conductor and falls as 1/x. Grading (capacitance or intersheath) evens it out. Economic size: R/r = e.

mcqs.q: Q1. Dielectric stress in a cable is maximum at
mcqs.ans: Ans: (d) The conductor surface g = V/(x ln(R/r)) is largest at x = r.

mcqs.q: Q2. Most economical R/r for a single-core cable
mcqs.ans: Ans: (b) e = 2.718 Gives minimum g<sub>max</sub> for given V.

mcqs.q: Q3. Purpose of grading a cable
mcqs.ans: Ans: (c) Make dielectric stress uniform Capacitance or intersheath grading.

mcqs.q: Q4. Insulation resistance as cable length increases
Q5. Cable capacitance as length increases
Q6. Belted cables are used up to about
mcqs.ans: Ans: (d) 11 kV (max 22 kV) Above that, tangential stress is a problem; use screened (H-type) cables.

mcqs.q: Q7. Charging current of a cable compared with an overhead line
mcqs.ans: Ans: (b) Much higher Conductors are close, so capacitance is high.

mcqs.q: Q8. Main advantage of a ring main
mcqs.ans: Ans: (b) Better continuity of supply Each load is fed from two sides.

mcqs.q: Q9. Kelvin's law gives the economical conductor size when
mcqs.ans: Ans: (b) Annual interest and depreciation = annual energy-loss cost Balances capital and running cost.

mcqs.q: Q10. Armouring on a cable protects against
mcqs.ans: Ans: (a) Mechanical damage Steel wires or tape; the sheath keeps out moisture.

mcqs.q: Q11. The most common fault in an underground cable is
mcqs.ans: Ans: (d) Earth fault (core to sheath) Insulation breaks down between core and earthed sheath.

mcqs.q: Q12. Murray loop test is used to
opts: (c) Locate the distance to a cable fault
mcqs.ans: Ans: (c) Locate the distance to a cable fault A bridge on the loop of faulty + sound cores.

mcqs.q: Q13. Pilot-wire (Translay) protection is used for
mcqs.ans: Ans: (b) Short feeders and cables Compares currents at both ends of the cable.
